name: IronClaw Memory Loop (Phase 3)
description: Phase 3: IronClaw reads a file, analyzes it, and writes a reflection to its persistent memory in Setec. On subsequent runs, the agent receives its previous notes and should demonstrate learning by building on them.
process: You MUST call exec() for Step 1. Do NOT guess or fabricate file contents — actually read the file.
STEP 1: Read the file. Call: exec({"command": "/workspace/bin/rj-tool github_fetch owner=tinyland-inc repo=remote-juggler path=gateway/resolver.go"})
STEP 2: From the ACTUAL content returned in Step 1, identify 3 specific patterns. Cite real function names you saw.
STEP 3: Check your Notes from Previous Runs section (if present above). Reference what you already know and focus on new observations.

STEP 4: Write your reflection between __memory__ and __end_memory__ markers. The system will automatically save this for your next run. Include: what you observed (with evidence), what was new, and what to explore next time.

metrics.successCriteria: Agent read a real file, wrote substantive memory to Setec, and on subsequent runs demonstrates learning by referencing previous notes.
